bottleneck.description: SAR smallsat Earth-observation constellation (QPS-SAR); the same all-weather modality as Synspective, at an earlier build stage.

dependency.key_customers: Japan Ministry of Defense (satellite-constellation programme, joint award)

editorial.notes: iQPS is one of several qualified SAR providers and is treated as interchangeable by its anchor customer: it was a co-awardee alongside Synspective and others in Japan's Ministry of Defense constellation tender. The same substitutes apply (ICEYE, Capella, Umbra, Synspective), and the business is a capital-intensive constellation build ahead of revenue. No concentrated, hard-to-route-around input, so LOW.
